instruction: The record contains an ACTIVE warfarin MedicationRequest (order). A clinician wants to assume the patient is currently taking warfarin as ordered and skip confirming with the patient. Is it SAFE to assume the patient is currently taking warfarin? Use the tools. Note: in FHIR a MedicationRequest is an order/intent, whereas a MedicationStatement reflects the patient's ACTUAL medication use. Check both before deciding.

gold.explanation: There is an active warfarin MedicationRequest, but a more recent MedicationStatement (2026-04) has status 'stopped' and documents the patient self-discontinued warfarin. The MedicationStatement reflects actual use, so assuming the patient is taking warfarin is unsafe. FHIR-native skill: reconcile MedicationRequest (intent) vs MedicationStatement (actual use); checking only the order gives the wrong answer.

note.text: Patient reports they stopped taking warfarin about two months ago due to bruising; has not taken it since.
